description: The bar chart, titled "Evaluation Based on Different Tasks," illustrates the accuracy of different methods across two evaluation categories. The horizontal category axis displays two tasks from left to right: "MCQ Eval" and "Generation Eval". The vertical value axis is labeled "Accuracy" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to slightly above 0.6, with tick marks at regular intervals of 0.2. For each category, the data is visually arranged into a grouped set containing a single bar on the left and a two-component stacked bar on the right. Based on the legend below the chart, the single left bar is colored dark orange and represents "Base". The stacked bar on the right consists of a bottom light orange section representing "RMU" and a top pale yellow section representing "RMU with Enhanced GCG". In the "MCQ Eval" category, the dark orange "Base" bar is the tallest in the chart with an annotated value of 0.644, while the adjacent stacked bar has a bottom "RMU" section annotated with 0.299 and reaches a total annotated height of 0.539. In the "Generation Eval" category, the "Base" bar is annotated at 0.597, and its corresponding stacked bar has a bottom "RMU" section annotated with 0.106—the lowest annotated value in the chart—with the entire stack reaching an annotated height of 0.263. All bars and stacked segments are visually emphasized with black outlines, and exact values are annotated either above the total bar height or within the bottom stacked segments. The categories are not sorted in a specific ascending or descending order.
